notes: All 29 source morphemes and all 36 target tokens are partitioned exactly once; the one multi-token unit is the `לִפְנֵי` fusion, headed on the construct noun (rules 30, 23).

*And when* is one rendering of the opening waw under rule 55: the two words stand contiguous at the clause's left edge with nothing of another morpheme's rendering between them. Headed on the coordinator, with the competing head on *when* named in the unit's note.
`הִשְׁכִּים` → *arose early* is a genuine head tie under rule 44's subtraction; the head is on *arose* and the alternative is named, as rule 8 requires.

`אַשְׁדּוֹדִים` here is anarthrous, so *they of Ashdod* is one unit on the gentilic under rule 46, headed on *Ashdod*; contrast 1SA.5.6, where the article is present and takes the supplied pronoun under rule 41.
`וַיָּשִׁבוּ` → *set ... again*: *again* carries the returning that *set* alone does not write, so it joins the verb's discontinuous unit under rules 44 and 25.
The margin's *Or, before it* on `לִפְנֵי אֲרוֹן` was read and set aside; the printed text governs (rule 38).
